name: Yuurei Shoujo Shitsu
source:
A shy girl Mare Terau comes to the big city to start her university life. However, her new apartment "Hakusansou" is rather run down and has certain rumors. 

Upon getting in her room, Mare meets a ghost girl Yuika. Yuika says she will get Mare out soon, but it turns out that Mare sees ghosts...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE216558.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
害羞的女孩马雷·特劳来到大城市开始她的大学生活。然而，她的新公寓“白山庄”相当破旧，并且有一些谣言。

进入房间后，马雷遇到了幽灵女孩尤伊卡。由伊卡说她很快就会把马雷救出来，但事实证明马雷看到了鬼……
